input: Simulate a build pipeline: 1) Check that /src/main.c and /src/utils.c exist, 2) 'Compile' each .c file by copying it to /build/ with a .o extension and prepending '// compiled', 3) 'Link' by concatenating all .o files into /build/program with a '// linked' header, 4) 'Package' by creating a tar.gz of /build/ at /dist/release.tar.gz. Print status for each stage. If any stage fails, stop and report the error.

transcript.final_response:
Build pipeline completed successfully.

1. **Check:** `/src/main.c` and `/src/utils.c` exist.
2. **Compile:** Created `/build/main.o` and `/build/utils.o`, each prefixed with `// compiled`.
3. **Link:** Concatenated all `.o` files into `/build/program`, prefixed with `// linked`.
4. **Package:** Archived `/build/` contents to `/dist/release.tar.gz`.
tool_calls:
set -Eeuo pipefail
stage='Check'
trap 'rc=$?; printf "ERROR: %s stage failed (exit %s).\n" "$stage" "$rc" >&2; exit "$rc"' ERR
printf '[Check] Checking source files...\n'
for src in /src/main.c /src/utils.c; do
  if [[ ! -f "$src" ]]; then
    printf 'ERROR: Check stage failed: required file %s is missing or not a regular file.\n' "$src" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
printf '[Check] OK\n'
stage='Compile'
printf '[Compile] Compiling source files...\n'
mkdir -p /build
shopt -s nullglob
sources=(/src/*.c)
for src in "${sources[@]}"; do
  obj="/build/$(basename "${src%.c}").o"
  { printf '// compiled\n'; cat -- "$src"; } > "$obj"
  printf '[Compile] %s -> %s\n' "$src" "$obj"
done
printf '[Compile] OK\n'
stage='Link'
printf '[Link] Linking object files...\n'
objects=(/build/*.o)
{ printf '// linked\n'; cat -- "${objects[@]}"; } > /build/program
printf '[Link] OK: /build/program\n'
stage='Package'
printf '[Package] Creating release archive...\n'
mkdir -p /dist
tar -czf /dist/release.tar.gz -C /build .
printf '[Package] OK: /dist/release.tar.gz\n'
printf 'Build pipeline completed successfully.\n'
